content:
sam_sales: Quick approval request — EdgeChannel wants a reseller margin exception. They asked for 35% on a 12mo $120k ARR commit (Redwood Dedicated + onboarding). Need deal desk ok to send proposal. POC blocked by security questionnaire until pricing is nailed down.

anya_partner_ops: What's the rationale for 35% vs our standard 25%? Are they bringing book or co-sell motion? :eyes:

sam_sales: They bring channel access to 3 mid-market ISVs and offered to commit to 10 seats reserved. Also willing to co-fund a tech POC ($15k). Their ask is higher margin because they'll own first-line support and field enablement.

jordan_deals: Need margin math. If standard margin is 25% on list price, 35% cuts net. Can we trade higher margin for a non-refundable MDF/commit credit?

mike_legal: Also flag: reseller agreement needs reseller-specific indemnity and data flow addendum. Approving margin doesn't sign legal terms. We'll need security questionnaire answered for POC — current status?

alice_cust_success: Security Qs stuck on encryption-at-rest and SOC2 evidence. Partner can host demo in our staging env if we sign an NDA and temporary access controls.

devon_reps: From revenue ops — if we give 35% we should require a 12-month minimum committed usage and an opt-out penalty. Also track margin in partner reporting.

pricing_bot: Auto-calculation — List price: $1,000/seat/mo * 10 seats * 12 = $120,000 ARR. 25% margin => partner rev $30,000, 35% => $42,000. Incremental cost to Redwood ~$12,000/year. [calc id=pc-9876]

jordan_deals: Proposal: counter-provide 30% margin + $10k MDF (payable upon POC completion) + 12mo commit with 60-day rollback clause. Legal to prep amendment.

anya_partner_ops: I can run this with EdgeChannel — they prefer margin now but MDF model acceptable. I'll ask for the security docs and push for NDA so staging POC can start.

mike_legal: Fine with drafting amendment but need approval from finance for margin delta and a note on resale territory. cc @finance_lead. Also suggest adding a temporary access clause: `reseller_margin = 0.30` in the commercial appendix.

sam_sales: Thanks. If finance ok, can we get pre-approval so I can lock pricing? POC timeline: want to start next week.

devon_reps: Looping in @finance_lead now. :thumbsup:
